text:
Mayank: thinking about surfacing SLO alert thresholds in the console. current ask: let tenants see "soft" vs "hard" thresholds, with noise preview and estimated alert fanout. thoughts?
Erica: big +1 for a preview. teams always get surprised by fanout. we should show estimated number of routed notifications per minute for the selected threshold.
Sophia: agree. also need per-route sampling and a quiet window option (eg business-hours only). show an example: `quiet_window: 22:00-07:00` and `sampling: 10%` so people can tune without generating ops noise.
Kevin: UX note — avoid exposing raw p50/p99 toggles unless you contextualize cost. users ask "what does this mean for my oncall?" so show expected emails/pagers and a cost delta (approx).
Mayank: good point. ops folks want the routing policy preview too — if we route to team A then oncall B, show escalation path and fallback. also show compatible fallback models (hosted vs dedicated) when capacity fallback will trigger.
Erica: implementation idea: keep core rule as `{"metric":"request_errors_percentage","window":"5m","threshold":2.5,"type":"soft"}` and a separate hard rule for reliability SLA. preview can run against last 14 days to show historical firings.
Mayank: here's a quick rule example we prototyped:
```json
{
  "name": "inference-err-rate-soft",
  "metric": "inference_error_rate",
  "window": "5m",
  "threshold": 1.5,
  "severity": "warning",
  "notify": ["#oncall-inference","pager:inference-team"],
  "sampling": 0.2,
  "quiet_window": "23:00-07:00"
}
```
Sophia: love it. can the preview simulate noise suppression heuristics? eg suppress repeats within 10m, group by tenant, dedupe identical stack traces.
Mayank: yes — we can surface which suppression heuristics applied and show before/after counts. that helps teams pick the right sensitivity.
Kevin: API debate: should the console call an evaluation endpoint (sync) to get preview, or we run it async and show a report? sync is simpler but heavy on infra. async gives more transparent history.
Erica: prefer async with a small sync fast-path for <1h lookbacks. queue jobs for longer windows and reuse cached results.
ops-bot: deploy scheduled: alert-preview-service -> v0.3.1 by @deploy-bot at 2026-02-14T16:45:00Z :rocket:
deploy-bot: smoke tests passed for preview endpoint.
Mayank: ux asks: show estimated oncall fanout, sample firing events, and an "impact score" that combines user-facing errors + latency regressions. that's more actionable than raw pct.
Sophia: also add a toggle to "apply to all routes" vs "apply to specific route". default should be route-scoped to avoid accidental tenant-wide changes.
Kevin: last thought — telemetry: export preview metadata (threshold chosen, sample rate, suppression rules) to audit logs so we can link regressions to config changes.
Erica: i'll draft a short spec and a mock for the console — will post in #eng-platform tomorrow. Mayank, can you add the preview API contract? then we can iterate.
Mayank: will do. thanks all :thumbsup:
